card.name: First word of a compound noun
card.fires_on: The first or middle word of a two-word compound where the next word is a set noun, e.g. 'blood' before clots or test, 'hot dog' before stand, 'car' before wash.

modes.label: Blood before clots/test
modes.description: The word 'blood' sits right before 'clots', 'test' or 'count' in medical warnings.
modes.example: may increase your chances of getting heart attacks, strokes, breast cancer, and<< blood>> clots.

modes.label: Everyday compound nouns
modes.description: Part of a common compound in general web text, such as hot dog stand or car wash.

modes.label: Other slots before a noun
modes.description: A small word or symbol where a fixed noun phrase is expected next.
modes.example: There will<< be>> cultural exhibits, crafts and entertainment for all

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a noun compound, such as cotton or consulting, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the first word of a fixed two-word phrase, like 'blood' in 'blood clots'.
